notes: Teaching language is English but the DAAD page notes that in higher semesters modules can be selected in German; German is not treated as a teaching language of the programme. Tuition is stated as none per semester. The application period on the DAAD page is given for the winter semester without a year (2 May - 15 July) and is valid for applicants from all countries, including non-EU applicants; it is recorded as a recurring deadline. The page points to HISinOne as the application route (university's own portal), so the channel is de-university-direct; no uni-assist VPD is mentioned for this Bachelor programme, only for a Master programme (Steuern und Rechnungslegung). The semester contribution of approx. 180 EUR is a social contribution, not tuition. No document list for this programme is stated on the pages.
